visual_prompt:
Product: AGUAJE COMPLEX 3 EN 1, for mujeres que quieren más volumen en glúteos y piernas (market: Colombia).
Benefits to use in the secondary texts (Spanish, short): Aumento de glúteos; Aumento de piernas y caderas; Triple acción con 3 extractos naturales; Sin efecto rebote (no engorda); Sin necesidad de hacer ejercicio de fuerza; Resultados visibles y naturales.
Angle: the SAME one as the reference ad (same body area, problem or desire, same hook). Only if the reference has no clear angle, use: Transformación / resultado.
WINNING CREATIVE CONCEPT of this reference (why it sells, in the owner's words; KEEP this concept, change only the execution details and the headline): 5 variaciones de su anuncio ganador para escalar con el sistema S.E.P. Misma estructura, colores rosados, frasco Aguaje Complex, íconos de beneficios (glúteos más firmes, piernas con más volumen, fórmula natural) y franja de oferta «Envío gratis · Paga al recibir». Solo cambian la modelo, el lugar,
Adapt the color palette to the product's packaging, keeping the same contrast and hierarchy as the reference.
All visible text in Spanish, perfectly spelled, with accents. The product must look exactly like the attached product photo.
WHAT CHANGES IN THIS VARIATION (and only this, the rest stays like the reference): Modelo en jean ajustado en una terraza al aire libre, pose de espaldas caminando, se notan muslos y glúteos
The headline PLAYS with the winning headline of the reference keeping its essence (same promise, same desire, same timeframe if it has one), never generic. If there is a before/after, the change must be obvious at first glance: two clearly different moments, the AFTER body visibly improved in the area of the angle. THE CLIENT ASKED: Replicar el anuncio ganador exacto: mismas zonas, letras, colores y oferta. Que el titular conserve la idea de «no solo glúteos, también piernas».

text_layers.reference_position: same place as the main headline of the reference
text_layers.text_style: same style as the main headline of the reference

mandatory_visual_elements: the real product from the attached product photo
final_generation_exclusions: any logo, brand name or text from the reference ad

forbidden_additions: the reference ad's brand, prices or claims
